protocol.hypothesis: Current amount percentile >= .95 plus a fixed known return20 <= .50 extension veto
protocol.purpose: Research stock leadership/liquidity selection; not a capital-capacity necessity
protocol.inputs: V3 frozen amount_percentile, explicit availability and current feature eligibility only
protocol.order: Current known amount gate and extension veto, then positive native utility and mainboard top 40, then exact signal-day official band >= .075
protocol.precision: Threshold represented in the stored factor dtype; no decimal rounding of percentiles
protocol.retained_positions: Unchanged; eligibility controls new purchases, never a forced-sale rule
protocol.predictions: All source rows and all native forecast columns retained without changes
protocol.extension_input: Signal-day complete-market-calendar adjusted return20 and its explicit availability mask
protocol.extension_unknown: Unknown return20 remains unknown and is not vetoed; no future quote or compressed-stock-calendar fallback
protocol.extension_threshold_origin: Reuse the prior monthly moderate-extension .50 hypothesis; twenty sessions is not calendar-month mom1; no threshold scan
